title: Countdown · A New Game Begins
next_chapter_hook: On the third night of seclusion, an unsigned letter appeared silently beside Chen Ji's pillow. On the envelope was only a single rune—the 'Heavenly Fate Mark' that had been lost from the Tianji Record for ages.

text.content: The Tianqing Sect's mountain gate loomed indistinct in the morning mist. Chen Ji ascended the blue stone steps one by one, his footsteps echoing distinctly in the silence. The two-month countdown hung like a sword over his head, and with each step, he felt that intangible pressure. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea pulsed with gentle warmth, as if reminding him: time was running out. The label of 'waste'—he would have to continue wearing it.

dialogue.content: Two months... that will be enough.

text.content: He murmured to himself, his tone so calm it seemed he wasn't discussing his own life and death. In his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul flickered: 'Kid, what are you planning to do? The secret of the incomplete Tianji Record can't stay hidden forever. The Eye of Heavenly Dao will eventually discover your existence.' A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's lips: 'Let it discover me. I want it to discover me.'

choice.prompt: After returning to the sect, Chen Ji needed to make his first decision: how to face the upcoming challenge?

choices.description: Using seclusion as a cover, secretly maneuver across the world while digesting the gains from the secret realm and enhancing strength to face the coming crisis.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of missing important external intelligence during seclusion
choices.risk_hint: Many variables during seclusion—need thorough preparations

text.content: Chen Ji returned to the Servants' Quarters but didn't rush to pack. He stood before the dilapidated wooden door, gazing at the mottled panels, and suddenly let out a soft laugh. Seclusion? Good. Since everyone was waiting to watch him become a laughingstock, let their jokes continue for a while longer.

dialogue.content: Go report to the Elder and say that I, Chen Ji, am entering seclusion for one month to digest the gains from the secret realm.

text.content: The news spread, and the entire Tianqing Sect scoffed. The waste wants to seclude himself for cultivation? Isn't that a joke? Yet what they didn't know was that while Chen Ji announced his seclusion, he had already foreseen everything that might happen next through the Tianji Record—every possible variable, every person who might betray him, every opportunity that might arrive.

choices.text: Secretly contact the various hidden pieces
choices.description: Maintain the waste persona on the surface while using secret channels to contact the hidden pieces deployed across all regions, beginning preparations for the decisive battle two months from now.
choices.risk_hint: Too large-scale movements may expose the setup

text.content: In the deep silence of night, Chen Ji sat alone on his worn bed, fingers tracing a complex rune in the air. The rune glowed faintly, then scattered into dozens of tiny points of light flying in all directions. Those were the pieces he had secretly positioned over the years—spread across the three major sects, the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, even the fringes of some Ancient Forbidden Lands.

dialogue.content: Kid, this move of yours is well-played. But don't forget, the Eye of Heavenly Dao is also watching you.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't respond to Mo Xiansheng's warning. He was waiting for a response, one from the most unlikely of places. And before that, he needed to ensure every move of his landed in the correct position.

However, plans couldn't keep up with changes. The day before Chen Ji was about to enter seclusion, an unexpected person appeared. Su Qingyao, Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, the number one among Tianqing Sect's younger generation. She came under the moonlight, her long skirt flowing, her cold demeanor carrying a trace of barely perceptible urgency.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, are you truly entering seclusion?

text.content: Su Qingyao's voice was cold as frost, yet carried a concern she herself hadn't noticed. Chen Ji looked at her, his heart stirring slightly. This woman had approached the truth three times, and three times he had cleverly deflected her. Now she appeared before him again, clearly having sensed something. He respectfully saluted without changing expression: 'Greetings, Senior Sister Su. Seclusion is my own decision and has nothing to do with others.'

dialogue.content: Others? You're quite good at distancing yourself.

text.content: Su Qingyao stepped closer, moonlight falling on her face, outlining her coldly beautiful features. Her gaze was almost tangible, as if trying to see through Chen Ji: 'In the secret realm, what exactly did you obtain? What was that presence that even made the Demonic Path's Saint Maiden Ye Qing turn pale?'

choice.prompt: Faced with Su Qingyao's questioning, Chen Ji needed to make a choice: how to deal with this woman who was getting closer to the truth?

choices.description: Persist with the waste persona, deflecting Su Qingyao's questions with various excuses, letting her continue believing he's just a lucky waste.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke greater suspicion from Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the status quo and preserve the disguise
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is no fool—multiple deflections may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji displayed a simple, honest smile, scratching his head: 'Senior Sister Su is joking. What presence could a waste like me have? That day in the secret realm, I just hid in a corner waiting to die, but luck was good and I picked up some scraps.'

Su Qingyao's gaze suddenly turned sharp. She stepped forward until they were almost face to face: 'Chen Ji, do you take me for a three-year-old?' Yet Chen Ji still maintained that harmless expression, even stepping back as if intimidated by her aura. This caused Su Qingyao's questions to hit cotton—powerful but nowhere to land.

choices.text: Appropriately reveal some of the truth
choices.description: Reveal some unimportant information to dispel Su Qingyao's doubts, while drawing her into his chess game as a reliable ally.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust and support
choices.risk_hint: Information leakage is risky—need precise control

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then sighed deeply. His expression became unprecedentedly serious: 'Senior Sister Su, some things—the more you know, the faster you die. Are you certain you want to hear?' These words made Su Qingyao pause slightly. She looked into Chen Ji's eyes, and there she saw no cowardice of a waste, only an abyss-like depth.

Su Qingyao's voice trembled slightly, whether from anger or something else. But she didn't retreat. Instead, she met Chen Ji's gaze: 'I've been investigating for three years. Whatever you are, I must know the truth.'

choices.text: Directly counter-question to test her stance
choices.description: Don't answer her questions. Instead, turn the tables and probe why she's so persistent about him, to understand whether she's friend or foe.
choices.visible_cost: May cause the other party's displeasure

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer her question. Instead, he stepped forward, the distance between them suddenly narrowing. He stared directly into Su Qingyao's eyes, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth: 'Senior Sister Su, let me ask you instead. You've investigated me for three years—for what? Suspicion, or... something else?'

Su Qingyao's expression instantly changed. A barely perceptible flush appeared on that coldly beautiful face. She sharply stepped back, her sword unsheathing three inches, the blade's light chilling: 'Chen Ji, you had better drop those little thoughts of yours!' Yet Chen Ji simply shook his head with a smile, that smile carrying an unfathomable depth.

In the end, Su Qingyao didn't pursue further. She drew an exquisite jade bottle from her sleeve and placed it on the stone table before Chen Ji. 'This is a Concentration Elixir—you can use it during seclusion. Don't misunderstand. I simply don't want a Tianqing Sect disciple to have accidents during seclusion and bring shame to the sect.' Her voice had returned to coldness, but those faintly reddened ear tips betrayed her.

Chen Ji took the jade bottle, thanking her sincerely. This thanks carried not a shred of pretense. Over these years, although Su Qingyao had always suspected him, she had also been secretly protecting him. In the secret realm, if not for her assistance, he wouldn't have obtained the Tianji Record Fragment so smoothly. This kindness, he remembered.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's care touched Chen Ji's heart. Before seeing her off, he needed to make a decision.

choices.description: Though they are currently on opposing sides, Chen Ji decides to include Su Qingyao within his protective scope in the future chess game, not allowing her to come to harm.
choices.visible_cost: May get entangled in greater troubles

text.content: Su Qingyao turned to leave but was stopped by Chen Ji. 'Senior Sister Su.' His voice was calm yet serious, 'Whether you believe it or not, there's one thing I can tell you—in the turmoil to come, I will ensure your safety.' Su Qingyao paused mid-step, glancing back. Complex light flickered in her eyes.

dialogue.content: A waste like you, to ensure my safety?

text.content: Chen Ji didn't argue, only smiling faintly: 'Senior Sister Su, time will tell.' That smile held no cowardice of a waste, only a chilling certainty. Su Qingyao gave him a deep look, said nothing more, and left. But in her heart, a trace of anticipation had quietly risen—how many secrets is this waste still hiding?

choices.text: Arrange hidden pieces to protect secretly
choices.description: Don't make any public statements. Instead, secretly arrange personnel to monitor Su Qingyao's safety, including her within the protective scope of his chess game.

text.content: After Su Qingyao left, Chen Ji stood still in silence for a long while. Moonlight fell, stretching his shadow long. He drew a jade talisman from his chest and gently crushed it. 'From today onward, assign someone to watch Su Qingyao. Anyone who harbors malicious intentions toward her...' He paused, a cold glint flashing in his eyes, 'Make them disappear.'

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rippled in his Mental Sea: 'For a woman, consuming setup resources—is it worth it?' Chen Ji gave no answer. His gaze passed beyond where Su Qingyao had left, toward the distant night sky. Tianqing Sect's former Patriarch Ling Yuan's residence—the lights there still burned. That old fox, after all, couldn't sit still anymore.
The setup has just begun.

Over the next three days, Chen Ji proceeded methodically with his arrangements. Using seclusion as cover, he actually employed the Tianji Record's foresight ability to investigate and eliminate various possible variables. Every disciple who might betray him, every link that might go wrong—he prepared countermeasures for all.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng, what conditions does the Tianji Record need for the next stage to unlock more?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in the Mental Sea, carrying a knowing smile: 'You've already completed the conditions for unlocking the first page. Next, you need to find a turning point—a clue to the whereabouts of the complete Tianji Record. Without it, you'll only ever see things within three hours.' Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly. The whereabouts of the complete Tianji Record—this was something he had been investigating, yet always without a clue.

As he contemplated, a gentle breeze passed. An unsigned letter silently appeared on the stone table before him. The envelope held a faint gray hue, bearing only a single rune—the 'Heavenly Fate Mark' lost from the Tianji Record for ages. Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. The first clue to the complete Tianji Record's whereabouts... could it come so quickly?

Chen Ji opened the envelope. Inside was only a thin as cicada wings paper, bearing eight characters: 'Kunlun's Peak, the Gate of Heavenly Secrets.' He didn't act rashly. Instead, he closed his eyes and used the Tianji Record to foresee the next three hours. He wanted to see what intention lay behind this letter. In his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled. Countless points of light gathered, forming a blurry image—a cloud-shrouded mountain peak, a massive stone gate faintly visible.

However, just as the image was about to become clear, a violent sting shot through his Mental Sea. Chen Ji grunted, opening his eyes to find that the Heavenly Fate Value on the Tianji Record Fragment had decreased by another 5 points. He gazed at the letter in his hands, a cold smile curling his lips. This letter was real, but the person behind it... friend or foe, that remained uncertain. The two-month countdown had begun, and the true chess game was just starting to unfold.
